main.description: The commits reachable from a revision that changed a path, newest first, a page at a time: follow `cursor` until it is absent. A repository never pushed has none at its default branch. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

errors.description: No such repository, revision, path or record.
errors.name: NotFound

checks.description: The newest run of each workflow at each of `commits`, by the runners the repository names; each says its commit.

path.description: The path, from the root; empty for the whole tree.

ref.description: The ref or commit shown, as `ref` named it, less any path.

cursor.description: How many commits the pages before held.

path.description: A path in the tree, from its root.

ref.description: A branch, a tag or a commit; the default branch if absent. It may run on into the path, as a web address names them: the longest branch or tag that starts it is the ref, and what follows goes before `path`.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

subjectOnly.description: Each commit's message cut to its first line, its subject, as a list of commits shows it: far less to send when squashed pulls carry their bodies.
